question: Can even immense material wealth justify giving away this kaula teaching?
premises: An ocean filled with jewels represents immense wealth
Such wealth might be offered as payment
inference: Even one who could accumulate an ocean filled with jewels should not be given it improperly
uncertainties: ratnasaṃpūrṇamakretuṃ is a fused and unclear form
plain_english: Even if one had the means to fill an ocean with jewels...
